text:
emma: hitting a publish failure when releasing sdk-node after typegen regen. two things: npm 401 mid-publish and semver-check blocking because dist diff flagged a reorder. opening thread to coordinate quick fixes.

emma: ```
$ ./scripts/release sdk-node
> typegen: regenerated models (openapi v1.44.0) -> changed export order
> build: ok
> npm publish packages/sdk-node --access public
npm ERR! code E401
npm ERR! 401 Unauthorized - PUT https://registry.npmjs.org/@redwood-inference/sdk-node
Publish aborted: semver-check failed (missing changelog fragment for minor bump)
```

ci-bot: pipeline publish-sdk job=6123 failed (step=publish) reason="401 + semver-guard" :robot_face:

jon: is the typegen change a true API change or just ordering? semver tool uses file diffs so reorder can trigger it.

emma: looks like reorder + one internal helper rename. no external surface change but dist hashes differ.

rachel: short-term fix: add a changelog fragment explaining non-breaking reorder and re-run. long-term: teach the semver diff to normalize typegen output before diffing.

ben: on the auth side, logs show token rotated mid-run by another workflow. publish step currently does 3 fixed retries; registry returned 401 on final attempt. we should use exponential backoff + token refresh on retry.

jon: agree. which to do first? auth prevents re-run so patch retry behavior quickly.

emma: I can requeue with a fresh token after adding a tiny changelog fragment to satisfy the guard. that'll unblock publish now.

ci-bot: job 6124 queued by emma.

ben: opened PR for publish action: https://git.internal/pr/5902 1 switch to retry util with exp backoff + token-refresh callback. assign to jon for review.

jon: reviewing, small nit on refresh timeout. will approve after tweak.

ci-bot: job 6124 started -> publish step invoked

emma: publish hit a transient 401 on attempt 2 but retry+refresh worked, semver fragment satisfied the check. package published as @redwood-inference/sdk-node@0.12.3.

rachel: thanks. will file INF-901 to add a sampleapp onboarding e2e that simulates registry auth rotation so we catch this earlier.

jon: also filing RFC INF-RFC-29 to add a typegen-normalizer before semver diffing. @ben @rachel please review.

emma: closing loop: job 6124 succeeded, PR #5902 merged to main, INF-901 and RFC-29 filed. tagging folks: @jon (RFC), @ben (retry patch), @rachel (e2e).

ci-bot: pipeline publish-sdk job=6124 succeeded :tada:
